notes: «و روي عن عبيد الله المرافقي قال» (al-Faqih): Ubayd Allah is the first link and narrates his own visit to the bath
first-person narrative with an unnamed speaker (rule 11): the bath-keeper, «شيخ كبير», speaks in the story and is not named, so he is not added
the Imam «أبي جعفر محمد بن علي» is described and spoken about, not the speaker: not a link
